instruction: Cinematic medium shot of six friends standing shoulder-to-shoulder on a rooftop at dusk. From left to right: the man with short gray hair (R2) in a gray hoodie, the woman with dark hair (R5) in a white jacket, the Black man (R6) in a dark blue jacket, the woman with light brown hair (R3) in a plaid shirt, the man with bleached hair (R4) in a brown jacket with a red bandana, and the woman with reddish-brown hair (R1) in a gray sweatshirt. The Black man (R6) has his arm around the woman with dark hair (R5), and the man with bleached hair (R4) has his arm around the woman with light brown hair (R3). They look forward with calm expressions. Soft, diffused evening light illuminates the scene against an overcast sky.
